_readme: Which AllSet Learning Chinese Grammar Wiki pages define each HSK grammar point (by ASG id; the titles are only for reading). is = pages about this point: their examples must match its rule. not = pages about OTHER uses of the same words: their examples must NOT match. unsure = related but neither (left out of the tests). Edit freely.
